messages.author: 66537eeccf3193f3
messages.subject: gl.recalc.metrics
parts:
Hi, I have a vcf file which I would like to use dartr to filter. I converted vcf to genlight then export the genotype table to excel where I calculate all loc.metrics parameters e.g. CallRate, FreqHomRef, FreqHomSnp, FreqHets etc. However, when I imported the data back into dartr, do gl.recalc.metrics and then gl.report.heterozygosity, I got double differences between Ho and He. I found that it was something to do with data conversion from genlight to excel and back. When I just run gl.report.heterozygosity on genlight without exporting, I got reasonable values of Ho and He. Is there a way to calculate loc.metrics parameters without having to export the data? 

I tried gl.recalc.metrics directly on the genlight object.
my.vcf = read.vcfR(filename) 
gl <- vcfR2genlight(my.vcf) 
gl.recalc.metrics(gl) #No loc.metrics generated

I tried generating loc.metrics dummy columns and used gl.recalc.metrics to fill in the numbers.
df <- data.frame(CallRate = c(1:length(g...@loc.names)), FreqHomSnp = c(1:length(g...@loc.names)))
gl@other$loc.metrics <- df
gl.recalc.metrics(gl) 
gl@other$loc.metrics$FreqHomSnp # This column doesn't get recalculated

Any suggestions would be much appreciated.
